name: Hen egg yolk, raw
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 523.1 g, protein 158.6 g, fat 265.4 g, ash 17.1 g, carbohydrate by difference 35.8 g, typical of raw hen egg yolk (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: Same conversion method as hen-egg-whole. The yolk carries almost all of the whole egg's fat, phosphorus and iron, reflected in a higher C share and phosphorus- and iron-led ash split than the white.
